answer: Topographic radio attestation curbs Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to physical channel states. Nodes beam microwave pulses between an elevated mesa and a bedrock knoll, sampling echoes inside a raven graphite shroud. Because local multipath profiles resist digital simulation, each forged identity demands the verifiable expense of a dedicated transceiver at a distinct physical site. However, severe precipitation alters RF propagation paths, periodically invalidating honest nodes.
